title: Orka.ai focused Groq regression — G033
note: Single-case regression for per-product unit totals, zero-order product inclusion, and deterministic alphabetical ordering.

cases.question: How many units of each product have been ordered?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS units_ordered FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY p.product_name;
